title_zh: 限定总部访谈对象与问题范围

scenario.goal_zh: 选定直接接触流程的访谈对象和具体问题，并约定报告仅反映所访团队

context_zh: 一名新员工向同事请教如何了解客户投诉的内部处理流程。
author: author-phase08-a

sentences.speaker: Paula
sentences.text: I'm visiting headquarters on Tuesday. Who could explain how complaints reach the product team?

sentences.speaker: Jin
sentences.text: Talk to Mara in customer support. She can give you insight into where the handover gets delayed.

sentences.speaker: Paula
sentences.text: Should I ask what everyone in the company thinks about the process?

sentences.speaker: Jin
sentences.text: That's too broad for one person. Ask her to walk you through a recent case without sharing customer details.

sentences.speaker: Paula
sentences.text: I'll ask where it arrived, who handled it next, and where she had to wait.

sentences.speaker: Jin
sentences.text: Good. Then label your notes as one team's experience, not a verdict on the whole company.

sentences.speaker: Paula
sentences.text: Understood. I'll send her those questions before the visit.
